title: A profile of Justin Sun, who made his fortune in the early phases of crypto, advised for Trump family's WLF, then sued WLF alleging fraud and breach of contract (Jen Wieczner/New York Magazine)
summary: Jen Wieczner / New York Magazine: A profile of Justin Sun, who made his fortune in the early phases of crypto, advised for Trump family's WLF, then sued WLF alleging fraud and breach of contract — Justin Sun was already one of the richest people in the world, having made his fortune in the no-rules early phase of the crypto industry …
